goal: Prevent adversaries from correlating private transaction broadcasts through timing side channels
Ensure outbound broadcast connections finish even if a transaction is returned early or invalidated
agreement: General agreement on the concept, but two objections await author response
Approach approval for completing connections and tracking disconnects (vasild)
Unaddressed objection: retry logic becomes effectively dead code, no author reply (mzumsande)
Unaddressed objection: potential integer underflow in future changes, no author reply (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a privacy side channel that lets peers correlate private transaction broadcasts
The timing attack is theoretical so it provides security hardening rather than an urgent bug fix
